committed_source_binding.scope: Exact tracked runtime files are bound to commit;78 generated import-cache files are separately byte-bound to the native capture and unchanged local runtime, not misrepresented as tracked git objects.

qualifiers: Eight actual Godot framebuffer PNGs from the full main scene. No generated, composited or synthetic screenshot imagery.

Completed-story recruitment eligibility and low/zero resources were explicitly prepared test fixtures; actual recruitment and selected-roster APIs were used. These are not gameplay-produced damage claims.
HUD reads the real GameState.party_resource_snapshot() API. Selected order, HP/Qi values and explicit downed text were checked against it.
Hover, Tab traversal, direct roster click and Escape used scripted Godot InputEvent delivery. This is not a claim of human manual play.
The compact case requests a 1179x737 window; aspect-kept Godot canvas output is 1179x736. Requested and actual dimensions are distinguished per frame.

All selected resources remain unchanged throughout. Browse checks preserve the complete per-case persistent state and perform no save writes. Intentional test setup changes selected roster and legal world origin between cases.
Only an isolated test save and isolated XDG data/config/cache profile are used. Existing user profiles and saves are untouched.
World/HUD overlap uses an explicit legal origin and the actual world actor positions/normal HUD occlusion response; no actor pose or renderer caches are edited.
No browser, Web export, audio, realtime FPS, battle-created damage, packaged release or publication acceptance is inferred from this capture.
